description: Defines the internal structure and functions for socket waiting using libevent, including socket registration, callbacks, and thread-safe wakeup mechanisms.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Internal structure managing socket waiters, including socket registration, event handling, and thread safety.

classes.name: Waitee
classes.description: Represents a registered socket with associated callback and interests.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Registers a socket with the waiter, specifying callback and interests.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Waits for an event with a timeout.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the waiter, optionally due to a timeout.

methods.name: HandleSignal
methods.description: Handles libevent callback signals for a Waitee.

methods.name: HandleWakeUpRead
methods.description: Handles wakeup signals from the wakeup pipe.

methods.name: AddWaitee
methods.description: Adds a Waitee to the registry.

methods.name: GetWaitee
methods.description: Retrieves the Waitee associated with a socket.

methods.name: RemoveWaitee
methods.description: Removes and returns the Waitee associated with a socket.
